schema: Both subsets preserve all 37 binary columns and their original values. They are nested views, not additional observations.
ff_normalization: For the consistency calculation, multiply FF by 100 if FF <= 1.5; the exported source value is unchanged.

consistency.note: Nominal irradiance is an analysis convention, not a recovered measurement for every row. Calculations use unrounded parsed input values.

duplicate_selection.after: Required fields, physical ranges and consistency selection
duplicate_selection.key_encoding: Exact stripped cell strings. A missing canonical material label falls back to the reported label. DOI is normalized from doi.
duplicate_selection.retention_order: Numeric record IDs first, in ascending numeric order; nonnumeric IDs then in lexical order. Retain a candidate only if neither its reported nor canonical key has already been retained.
duplicate_selection.scope: This subset rule does not include preparation conditions and is distinct from source-based deduplication of the primary collection.

interpretation: SMILES must be nonempty under the missing-token convention. Subset membership does not certify chemical identity or provide independent extraction-accuracy validation.
